jobs.description:
**Overview:**
* We are seeking an experienced Full Stack Developer with strong expertise in the MERN stack (MongoDB, Express.js, React.js, and Node.js) to design, develop, and deploy scalable, cloud\-based, AI\-enabled applications.
* The ideal candidate will have strong full\-stack development experience along with hands\-on exposure to integrating Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), AI APIs, Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG), semantic search, and intelligent automation into modern applications.
* This role is focused on building applications powered by AI, rather than developing or training AI/ML models from scratch. The developer will work across frontend, backend, databases, APIs, cloud infrastructure, and AI integrations to deliver secure, scalable, and production\-ready applications.

**Responsibilities:**
* Design, develop, test, deploy, and maintain scalable web applications using the MERN stack.
* Develop responsive and reusable frontend components using React.js.
* Build backend services, APIs, and application logic using Node.js, Express.js, and/or Nest.js.
* Design and develop RESTful and GraphQL APIs and integrate third\-party and enterprise services.
* Integrate LLMs and Generative AI APIs into web and enterprise applications.
* Build AI\-enabled features such as intelligent search, conversational interfaces, document processing, summarization, classification, information extraction, recommendations, and workflow automation.
* Develop Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG) solutions using enterprise data, documents, embeddings, semantic search, and vector databases.
* Implement prompt management, AI workflow orchestration, structured outputs, validation, and appropriate guardrails for AI\-generated content.
* Design and optimize data models using MongoDB, PostgreSQL, and/or MySQL.
* Develop secure authentication, authorization, role\-based access, and API security.
* Build reusable application components, services, integrations, and development frameworks.
* Optimize application performance, scalability, reliability, security, and AI service utilization.
* Implement application and AI workflow logging, monitoring, error handling, and observability.
* Develop unit, integration, API, and automated tests to ensure application quality.
* Participate in architecture discussions, technical design, code reviews, and development standards.
* Support CI/CD, Docker/containerization, and AWS/GCP cloud deployments.
* Collaborate with Product, UI/UX, QA, DevOps, and AI/ML teams throughout the development lifecycle.
* Evaluate emerging AI technologies and identify opportunities to incorporate them into applications.

**Qualifications:**
* Around 5 or more years of professional Full Stack/Application Development experience.
* Strong hands\-on expertise with MongoDB, Express.js, React.js, and Node.js (MERN).
* Strong proficiency in JavaScript and TypeScript.
* Strong frontend development experience with React.js.
* Strong backend development experience with Node.js and Express.js.
* Experience designing and developing RESTful APIs, GraphQL APIs, and microservices.
* Strong experience with MongoDB and exposure to relational databases such as PostgreSQL and MySQL.
* Hands\-on experience integrating Generative AI/LLM APIs into applications.
* Understanding of LLMs, prompt engineering, RAG, embeddings, semantic search, and vector databases/vector search.
* Experience developing AI\-powered features such as conversational interfaces, intelligent search, document processing, or workflow automation.
* Experience with AWS and/or Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
* Experience with Git, CI/CD, Docker, automated testing, and modern software development practices.
* Good understanding of application security, authentication, authorization, and secure API development.
* Strong analytical, debugging, and problem\-solving skills.
* Ability to independently take ownership of features from design through production deployment.
* Experience with Nest.js, GraphQL, Angular, Ruby on Rails, Python, LangChain/LlamaIndex, vector databases, Kubernetes, or serverless technologies is a plus.

jobs.description:
**Discover your future at Citi**
--------------------------------


Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a team of approximately 219,000 dedicated people from around the globe. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact.


**Job Overview**
----------------


We are seeking an experienced and motivated **Java Spark Developer** to design, develop, and maintain high\-performance, large\-scale data processing pipelines and distributed applications. In this role, you will leverage **Core Java** and **Apache Spark** to build resilient batch and real\-time streaming data architectures, optimize distributed data workloads, and collaborate with cross\-functional teams including Data Scientists, Cloud Engineers, and Solution Architects.

  

  

**1\. Data Pipeline \& Application Development**
------------------------------------------------


* Design, implement, and maintain robust, scalable data ingestion and ETL/ELT pipelines using **Apache Spark (Core, SQL, Streaming)** written in **Java** (or Scala interoperability).
* Develop performant, low\-latency microservices and distributed processing modules integrated with messaging platforms (e.g., Apache Kafka).
* Build and maintain interfaces to relational databases, distributed data lakes, and NoSQL stores (e.g., Hive, Cassandra, HBase, MongoDB, Delta Lake, Snowflake).

**2\. Performance Tuning \& Optimization**
------------------------------------------


* Profile, debug, and optimize Spark jobs by managing partitioning strategies, caching, broadcast variables, memory allocation (driver/executor memory), and data serialization (Kryo).
* Analyze query execution plans, DAGs, and Spark UI metrics to eliminate data skew, reduce shuffle overhead, and minimize bottleneck latencies.
* Monitor resource utilization on cluster managers such as Kubernetes, Apache YARN, or cloud\-native orchestration engines.

jobs.description:
As a Lead Engineer – Embedded SW Development (LPB2\), you will be a technical cornerstone in the development and evolution of the MarkVIe control platform. Operating within a global, cross\-functional environment, you will drive the design, implementation, and optimization of firmware for state\-of\-the\-art power generation control systems. You will provide technical leadership, mentorship, and architectural guidance to ensure the reliability and performance of embedded software — all while embodying the GE Vernova Way through a relentless focus on safety, integrity, customer impact, and continuous learning.
**Job Description**
===================


**Essential Responsibilities**


* **Technical Leadership:** Translate high\-level system requirements into robust firmware architectures and low\-level design specifications.
* **Full\-Cycle Development:** Lead the design, coding, testing, and debugging of mission\-critical system software for the MarkVIe platform.
* **Performance Optimization:** Analyze and enhance the efficiency, stability, and scalability of system resources to meet stringent power generation requirements.
* **Validation \& Integration:** Integrate new product designs and collaborate with firmware test teams to develop, perform, and oversee formal design verification and validation (V\&V) plans.
* **Quality Assurance:** Lead high\-quality technical reviews, including detailed design, source code, unit test frameworks, and requirement documentation.
* **Cross\-Functional Collaboration:** Serve as a primary interface between hardware design, systems engineering, and product teams.
* **Continuous Improvement:** Champion automated unit and regression testing initiatives; foster a culture of continuous improvement in both product quality and development processes.
* **Lifecycle Management:** Manage software throughout the entire product development lifecycle, from project initiation and design to release and long\-term maintenance.
* **Assessment:** Evaluate and integrate third\-party and open\-source software components while maintaining compliance with cybersecurity standards.

**Qualifications/Requirements**


* **Education:** Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Electronics Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.
* **Experience:** 6\-9 years of professional experience in embedded software programming, with a demonstrated ability to perform hands\-on development and complex troubleshooting on embedded targets.
* **Technical Proficiency:**
	+ Advanced C/C\+\+ programming skills.
	+ In\-depth understanding of microprocessor architectures.
	+ Hands\-on experience with preemptive, multitasking Real\-Time Operating Systems (RTOS), with a strong preference for **QNX**.
* **Methodologies:** Proven experience in Agile development environments and automated unit testing for C/C\+\+.
* **Toolsets:** Proficiency in software configuration management tools, defect tracking systems, and peer\-review processes.
* **Communication:** Excellent interpersonal skills with a proven track record of working effectively in global, multi\-functional teams.

**Desired Characteristics**


* **Domain Expertise:** Direct experience with MarkVIe control systems firmware development.
* **Protocol Knowledge:** Experience working with industrial communication protocols (e.g., MODBUS, Profibus, Profinet, Foundation Fieldbus, CAN, Industrial Ethernet).
* **Security Mindset:** Knowledge of secure software design and cybersecurity practices for industrial control systems.
* **Leadership:** Demonstrated experience leading global programs and mentoring junior engineers.
* **Versatility:** Exposure to C\# development for tooling or utility applications is a strong plus.
* **Initiative:** A self\-starter mindset with the ability to navigate complex, cross\-functional technical challenges autonomously.

**Additional Information**
==========================


**Relocation Assistance Provided:** Yes
